Name: SNES Carnivorous Plant Meat Trees for Animal Husbandry
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
This mod adds several Carnivorous Plants in the form of fruit trees that will produce meat items from the Animal Husbandry mod. Where do these meat products come from? Don't worry about it. You can buy them at Pierre's for now.


Features:
Wimpy Flower, Carniflower, and Flowering Death are based upon enemies from Secret of Evermore. They make the following meat items as fruits in spring, summer, and fall:

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Wimpy Flower[/b][/size][/color][size=4]:[/size] Rabbit
[color=#f9cb9c][size=4][b]Carniflower[/b][/size][/color][color=#d5a6bd]:[/color] Pork
[color=#9fc5e8][size=4][b]Flowering Death[/b][/size][/color]: Beef

Fly Trap, Meat Eater, and Man Eater are based upon enemies from Chrono Trigger. They make the following meat items as fruits in spring, summer, and fall:

[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b]Fly Trap[/b][/size][/color] : Bug Meat
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Meat Eate[/b][/size][/color][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]r[/b][/size][/color]: Mutton
[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b]Man Eater[/b][/size][/color]: Ostrich

The Demonic Rafflesia and Demonic Petunia are based upon enemies from Earthbound. They make the following meat items as fruits in spring, summer, and fall:

[color=#dd7e6b][size=4][b]Demonic Rafflesia[/b][/size][/color][color=#dd7e6b]:[/color] Chicken
[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]Demonic Petunia[/b][/size][/color]: Duck

[b][size=5]Version 2[/size] [/b]adds in three new plants based on Piranha Plants from the Mario games. They will grow in a pipe and provide crab pot items in spring, summer, and fall:

[size=4][color=#e06666][b]Saltwater Piranha Plant[/b][/color][/size][size=3]: Clams, Cockles, Mussels, Oysters[/size][size=4]
[b][color=#a2c4c9]Freshwater Piranha Plant[/color][/b][/size][size=3]: Snails, Periwinkles, Crayfish[/size][size=4]
[b][color=#6aa84f]Amphibious Piranha Plant[/color][/b][/size][size=3]: Crabs, Lobsters, and Shrimp[/size]

[size=3]went ahead and added a forth one that does beach forage too[/size][size=4]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Beachcombing Piranha Plant[/b][/size][/color][size=3]: [/size][size=4]Rainbow Shell, Nautilus Shell, Coral, Sea Urchin[/size][/size]
[size=4][size=4]cross-mod plants added in ver 6[/size][/size]
[size=4][color=#fff2cc][b]Mountaineering[/b] [b]Nipper Plant[/b][/color]: [/size][size=3]Crabpot-ish fish from Ridgeside Village[/size]
[size=4][color=#666666][b]Tidepooling [/b][b]Muncher Plant[/b][/color][/size]: [size=3]Nudibranches from East Scarp[/size]

[size=5][b]Version 3 [/b][/size][size=4][size=4] brings a new set of 4 plants based upon Tyrant Triffids from Joe and Mac. They are [b]optional cross-mod[/b] plants that will produce the meats from my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30907]Livestock Dinos (required for these)[/url]
[color=#b6d7a8][b]Tyrant Triffid[/b]:[/color] Dinosaur Meat
[color=#a2c4c9][b]Soverign Sagileocorn[/b][/color]: Mammoth Meat
[b][color=#e06666]Monarch Maw[/color][/b]: Pterosaur Meat
[color=#b4a7d6][b]Commandant Chomper[/b]:[/color] Beast Meat

This update should also hopefully fix the issue with optional mod trees showing up as error items, oops.

[size=5][b]Version 4  [/b][size=4]Adds a set of trees for Milk of Myth support, see below
[size=4][size=4][size=5][b]Version 5  [/b][size=4]Adds a set of trees for Rose's Cruelty Free Meat and Trent's New Animals, see below[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[size=5][b]Version 6[/b][/size][size=4][b]  [/b]Adds a set of trees for Mizu's animal mods, and one each for RSV and East Scarp.[/size]

[b][size=5]feel free to translate![/size][/b]

Prices were made up suddenly so they are not likely to be terribly balanced, that is not really my field of expertise so if someone wants to do some math and suggest proper prices lemme know in the comments. There are probably some weird bits of graphics / collision.

This does require the Animal Husbandry mod. If someone would like to make alternative versions for other meat mods, go for it.
[b][size=5]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods](Most of) MizuJakkaru's Animal Mods[/url]
